title: Explanation text sits on the page: a subtitle on Lists and a 2-line paragraph under the paste box
what_happens: Lists has 'Named groups of phone numbers. A number can be in more than one list.' under its title. The list page has 'One per line: phone, then an optional name and language (en or es)... Numbers without a + are read as Costa Rica. With no language, +506 numbers get Spanish and the rest English.' always shown under the textarea.
who_hurts: Admins scanning the page: the text adds weight and length every visit, though it is only needed the first time someone pastes numbers.
suggested_fix: Drop the Lists subtitle (the title and rows say it). Move the paste rules behind a small 'i' Tooltip next to the 'Or paste numbers' label (components/ui/tooltip is already used on this page); the placeholder already shows the format.
rule: Dane's UI rule: 'Keep explanation off the top level of the page... text that explains what it does goes behind a small "i" icon or tooltip.'
